items.title: As Clarity Act teeters, mystery group hammers away at crypto in Washington ads
items.summary: Crypto Watchdog has taken to warning people in DC about the hazards of digital assets, and its director won't say who is backing it.

items.title: Live updates: Bitcoin stuck in tight range as risk assets soar on Iran deal hopes
items.summary: Japan may have spent as much as $36.6 billion buying yen in the first joint US-Japan action to support the currency since 1998. Bitget Wallet’s Alvin Kan says it can slow a disorderly slide without reversing the broader trend.

items.title: Texas electric grid moratorium won’t have big impact on BTC miners: Bernstein
items.summary: Monday’s announcement that Texas Governor Greg Abbott set a moratorium on approval of ERCOT-linked data centers pending an audit won’t impact miners’ approved electricity contracts.

items.title: US yen intervention puts Bitcoin, risk assets on notice for liquidity flux
items.summary: The first US-Japan joint yen intervention in 28 years came amid record bond yields and worries about the yen carry trade.

items.title: Why bitcoin’s ‘500-day rule’ faces its biggest test yet
items.summary: The so-called ‘500-day rule’ says buying BTC roughly 500 days before a bitcoin halving and selling it about 500 days after would have produced profits in prior cycles.

items.title: Live updates: An AI credit bubble could set up bitcoin’s path to $1 million
items.summary: Maelstrom co-founder Arthur Hayes says overleveraged AI data-center spending will eventually crack, forcing government bailouts and money printing that become the next major bitcoin catalyst.

items.title: The worst chart for bitcoin bulls right now
items.summary: For 14 years, one ratio moved only in bitcoin's favor. Now it has decisively turned the other way and bulls may not like what it means.

items.title: New Ethereum proposal would cut issuance to zero if staked ETH reaches $112 billion
items.summary: The EIP-8361 draft proposal calls for burning a rising share of validator rewards as the staking ratio climbs.

items.title: "You stole, please return some." Coldcard hacker's wallet becomes a graffiti wall of pleas and hustles
items.summary: A wallet holding $36 million in stolen bitcoin has become an unlikely public message board, as hack victims and opportunists pay to leave permanent notes for the thief.

items.title: Bitcoin flat at $64,000 as stocks print records and Hormuz deal nears
items.summary: BTC held near $64,000 as MSCI's world index set another peak and Brent fell toward a Hormuz deal. Ether is the only major down on the week.

items.title: BlackRock brings tokenized money market funds to Europe via JPMorgan
items.summary: JPMorgan’s Kinexys platform will tokenize select BlackRock money market fund shares denominated in pounds, euros and US dollars.

items.title: Proof of Play to shut down after blockchain gaming thesis falls short
items.summary: The a16z-backed studio will open-source Pirate Nation assets, while an independent foundation continues supporting the PIRATE token.

items.title: Forgd brings its crypto market-maker leaderboard to DefiLlama
items.summary: Forgd’s ratings draw on data from more than 500 token projects and 35 market-making firms, but do not solely reflect trading performance.

items.title: Boerse Stuttgart Digital, Tradias close European crypto merger
items.summary: The completed tie-up combines Boerse Stuttgart Digital’s custody business with Tradias’ trading operations under a joint management team.

items.title: MiCA list expands with 12 companies in fourth post-deadline update
items.summary: ESMA’s latest MiCA update brings the number of authorized CASPs to 321 and adds three entities to its non-compliant register.

items.title: Taiwan plans Travel Rule for domestic crypto transfers from October
items.summary: Taiwan’s regulator plans to apply the Travel Rule to domestic VASP transfers from October before extending it to overseas platforms by the end of 2027.

items.title: Missouri trio charged over alleged Bitcoin kidnapping plot
items.summary: The defendants allegedly traveled from Missouri to Connecticut to kidnap a Bitcoin holder and force him to transfer cryptocurrency before abandoning the plan.

items.title: Cloudflare introduces wallets for AI agents, plans stablecoin payments
items.summary: Cloudflare introduced programmable Wallets for AI agents and said payment features using stablecoins will launch in a future update.
